name: Revisiting the Robustness of Watermarking to Paraphrasing Attacks
publisher: Rastogi and Pruthi, Indian Institute of Science. Shows a limited number of black-box generations from a watermarked model suffices to reverse-engineer the scheme and make paraphrase evasion effective, including against schemes designed to be paraphrase-robust. DIRECTLY CONTRADICTS the robustness claims in the literature it surveys - see the contested paraphrase record.
